note: prompts of the Qwen3.5-9B reader (classification, then one extraction prompt chosen by the class) and the GLM-OCR second reader (the corpus pipeline's table prompt). Text in the images is Russian; the model must copy it as printed.

decoding.retry: an answer that runs into the token cap is asked once more with the same prompt: a greedy repetition loop with presence_penalty RETRY_PRESENCE_PENALTY, a long answer that is not a loop with max_tokens LONG_RETRY_MAX_TOKENS; the retry and its kind are recorded
decoding.retry_kinds: loop (the last 40 non-empty lines hold at most 6 distinct lines) -> presence_penalty; otherwise a long answer -> the same decoding with LONG_RETRY_MAX_TOKENS

glm_table.image_mode: L (8-bit grey lossless PNG, as the pipeline)

TABLE_SCREENSHOT:
Transcribe the table in this image exactly, cell by cell.
Rules:
- Copy every visible cell exactly as printed: same language (do not translate), same spelling, same decimal commas or points, signs, units, dashes and spacing inside numbers.
- Keep the row order and the column order of the image. Do not sort, merge, compute, round or complete anything.
- An empty cell is "". A cell you cannot read with certainty is "UNREADABLE". Never guess.
- A header cell that spans several columns (a header group) goes to header_groups with the 0-based indices of the first and last column it covers; columns lists the lowest header row, one entry per column.
- If the image is a spreadsheet screenshot, the spreadsheet's own column letters (A, B, C ...) and row numbers are not table cells: put visible row numbers in sheet_row_numbers (one per data row, "" if not visible) and leave them out of rows.
- Rows cut off at the image border: transcribe what is visible and mark the missing part UNREADABLE.
Answer only with JSON:
{"title": "<text printed above the table or \"\">", "header_groups": [{"text": "...", "first_col": 0, "last_col": 0}], "columns": ["..."], "rows": [["..."]], "sheet_row_numbers": ["..."], "mine_as_printed": ["<mine / рудник names exactly as printed anywhere in the image>"], "notes": "<what is cut off or unreadable>"}
PHOTO:
Describe this photograph in 2-3 sentences and copy any printed text or scale in it.
Answer only with JSON: {"description": "...", "printed_text": ["..."], "mine_as_printed": ["..."]}
COMMON_SUFFIX: Write every list entry only once (a table row is written once, as printed), never repeat an entry to fill space, and end the JSON when everything printed has been reported.
OTHER:
Copy all text, symbols and numbers printed in this image exactly, and say in one sentence what it is.
Answer only with JSON: {"what": "...", "printed_text": ["..."], "mine_as_printed": ["..."]}
